prompt: Create a highly photorealistic luxury studio photoshoot of a clearly adult Portuguese woman with a naturally beautiful European appearance, dressed in an attractive, stylish, contemporary outfit that feels confident and effortlessly fashionable rather than formal. Overall aesthetic: attractive Portuguese woman, modern European fashion, casual luxury, sophisticated but non-formal styling, minimalist studio, understated elegance, authentic beauty, premium fashion editorial, realistic photography, natural retouching, no excessive glamour effects, no artificial-looking skin.
